name: The Birch
description: Horror stories told from the perspectives of multiple characters whose lives are affected by the Birch, a bloodthirsty monster deep in the woods. Once you summon her protection, you never escape.

videos.title: I Went to the Woods. Something Creepy Happened.
videos.overview: Kelly Bernstein has been looking for her brother for ten years. Does the clue she found in the woods mean he's still alive?

videos.title: Return to the Woods + A Weird Email
videos.overview: Kelly returns to the woods in search of what she saw in her video—and makes an unexpected discovery.

videos.title: I Found Something Creepy In My Brother's Lock Box...
videos.overview: Kelly opens her brother's lockbox and discovers a long-lost message.

videos.title: Is The Kings Point Killer The Birch?
videos.overview: Shocked by a series of gruesome murders, Kelly sends an urgent warning.

videos.title: Tracking the Birch
videos.overview: As her obsession with The Birch grows deeper, Kelly gets a disturbing phone call.

videos.title: Evie's Missing. I'm Going To Find Her.
videos.overview: Kelly processes the disturbing news from Kings Point—and prepares to take her hunt for the Birch to a new level.

videos.title: Through The Woods
videos.overview: High school loner, Evie Grayson, finds herself in over her head when she witnesses three teenage local drug dealers commit murder deep in the woods. Brutally threatened into silence, Evie decides to do what no one else in her town of King's Point will do...take the dealers down.

videos.title: Postpartum
videos.overview: Teenager Lanie Bouchard, finds herself exhibiting disconcerting symptoms after she secretly gives birth to her daughter, Laura. Her adoptive parents planned to keep the pregnancy a secret and raise Laura as Lanie’s sister, but when Lanie sets eyes on her daughter and falls in love, she finds her parents' rules of separation too drastic to abide and decides she’ll do whatever it takes to be near her...

videos.title: Blood Money
videos.overview: After Thurston Polk threatens the lone witness of his crime into silence, he and his friends find themselves stalked by a less-than-friendly forest spirit intent on vengeance...

videos.title: Thee Who Breaks Me
videos.overview: In an act of desperation to protect against losing the one parent she has left, Evie calls upon the Birch once more.

videos.title: She's Coming To Get Us
videos.overview: After Ryan’s brutal assault the night before, Thurston and Wes pay their friend a visit in the hospital, only to be warned in veiled terms that Evie is coming to hurt them.

videos.title: Skeletons in the Closet
videos.overview: Forced apart from her daughter and thrown back into teenage 'normalcy' at high school, Lanie finds her maternal instincts coming out in bizarre ways. With the situation at home growing increasingly strained, she turns to old sources for strength and purpose...

videos.title: Jailbreak
videos.overview: After Thad’s gruesome death, Lanie finds the house on lockdown as her parents' rules grow increasingly harsh. Dying to connect with her daughter, she takes drastic measures to run away and start over, but her sanctuary is short-lived.

videos.title: Creepy Eve Is The King's Points Killer
videos.overview: Word has spread of Evie’s potential connection to the deaths of Ryan and Wes, making Evie even more of a social pariah. Returning home to learn that her father has been assaulted by men working for the Polks, Evie decides to pay Thurston a retaliatory visit at his uncle’s shop.

videos.title: Flesh and Blood
videos.overview: After another disturbing loss, Thurston tries to get the hell out of dodge earlier than planned with Gavin. However, his worst fears are soon realized when his brother becomes the new target of the Birch.

videos.title: I Will Be Calm
videos.overview: Lanie wakes to find herself locked away in a mysterious bunker under the watchful eye of Dr. Sampson. But with Lanie growing more aware of her abilities, Dr. Sampson doesn't realize the power she's up against...

videos.title: Making Amends
videos.overview: Waking with regrets, Evie decides to put an end to the bloodshed, but The Birch has other plans. After all, a mother’s love never dies.

videos.title: Murphy's Law
videos.overview: After pleading with Evie to spare Gavin’s life, Thurston is caught by Sebastian and his men. When Thurston comes clean to them about Evie's blood-quest, Sebastian proposes a simple solution to their problems - kill the Graysons.

videos.title: Love Is Colder Than Death
videos.overview: Sickened and exhausted by the bloodshed, can Evie and Thurston work together to end their feud by targeting the true source of both their problems?

videos.title: A Mother's Love Never Dies
videos.overview: Lanie returns home to rescue Laura and enact vicious vengeance on her parents, who she learns have morbid plans in store for them both.

videos.title: New Blood
videos.overview: The King's Point Killer has disappeared, but the Birch's inspiration lives on in another young high school girl. When Rory is bullied online by her crush, she summons the protective spirit to seek revenge.

videos.title: The Hidden Place
videos.overview: Trapped in the Birch's garden, Evie can hear another young, vulnerable girl, Rory, following in the footsteps of the King's Point Killer, and plots her escape.

videos.title: Cherry Blossom
videos.overview: Rory summons the Birch to take revenge on her crush. Returning to King's Point, Evie rushes to get to Moses before the Birch does.

videos.title: The Favorite Child
videos.overview: With baby Laura in tow, Evie meets Rory- a girl who would love to be her twin sister- to warn her about the Birch's twisted power. Learning that her revenge spell worked, Rory targets her next victims.

videos.title: Asylum
videos.overview: While Rory continues her quest for revenge against everyone who's wronged her, Evie finds refuge with Jihan, a social worker who believes Evie is a young mother fleeing an abusive relationship. But Jihan's brother, Razi, isn't so trusting...

videos.title: Time to Atone
videos.overview: Rory puts her dark plan in motion, preparing to sacrifice hundreds of her classmates. When the Birch attacks at the community centre, Jihan must decide if she's going to trust Evie's word or walk away.

videos.title: Into the Roots
videos.overview: Rory livestreams her last message as she seeks revenge on everyone who ever hurt her, while Evie and Jihan go to a place where nothing grows to meet the one other living person with knowledge of the Birch.

videos.title: The Birthday Party
videos.overview: Rory celebrates her 17th birthday with cupcakes and her mother tied up with vines. Can Evie stop her in time to prevent mass murder?

videos.title: The Garden of Lost Children
videos.overview: Evie is pulled back to the Birch's garden, while Rory enacts revenge against her tormentors. Even if Evie can escape, is there any way to stop the Birch?

videos.title: Abandonment
videos.overview: Jihan, Razi and Evie square off for a final showdown with the Birch. But a mother's love never dies...
